text: Brown-Forman is a publicly traded company: both classes of its common stock trade on the New York Stock Exchange, and it has owned Jack Daniel's since 1956.
short: Brown-Forman (NYSE) has owned Jack Daniel's since 1956.

source.name: Wikipedia – Brown-Forman
source.quote: Brown-Forman has two classes of common stock, both of which are traded publicly on the New York Stock Exchange.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Jack Daniel's
additionalSources.quote: In 1956, the company was sold to the Brown-Forman Corporation.
